title: Metch
tagline: Metch is a dapp for connecting hackers to form teams and build ideas as well as keep them informed about new hacking events.
description:
The objective of metch is to be the tool that all hackers use when they need to look for a team for start building at these kind of hacking events.

In my personal experience hacking I noticed that forming teams on discord could not be the best way to do it, Although it works I think there could be a much cooler approach rather than reading many messages all of them with different structures, for example some hackers say they want to join a team, others say they need people for their teams, others comment ideas to build, among other type of messages . Besides we don’t know if someone is already taken for a team until we ask them. Metch comes and makes this easier.

It has several cool features such as:
 ⁃ Matching system
 ⁃ Reputation system
 ⁃ Chat
 ⁃ Calendar for upcoming events
 ⁃ And more that I would like to work on
how_its_made:
The metch dapp uses Lens Protocol for profiles and publications(ideas) creation. I  linked these two features with Push Chat so that users can connect with other hackers in a matching system (similar to a dating app but for creating team group chats).

It also implements a reputation system using the Attestation Station contract by Optimism. In this system hackers recognizes other hackers sending badges to them.
